caption: The drawing depicts a wooden wall clock with a rectangular case featuring a dark reddish-brown wood grain pattern. The clock has two main sections: the upper section contains a circular clock face with black Roman numerals on a pale, cream-colored background, and black hour and minute hands in front of a gold and black central disk. The lower section displays a painted scene of a white building with a central tower and spire, surrounded by green trees and a grassy landscape, all enclosed behind a glass panel. The structure is supported by turned columns on each side and rests on a broad, slightly protruding base shelf with small decorative supports. The entire clock is set against an off-white or light beige plain background. The artist's signature appears in the lower right corner of the image.
title: Wall Clock with Mantel
